title: Cross-sectional convergence after the first completed reaction bar to a BTC shock

inputs: mark price klines for funding valuation
data.quality_policy: fail before PnL on corrupt ZIP, hash mismatch, invalid or duplicate row, non-contiguous required 5m contract or mark series, missing archive, or missing feature/entry/exit/funding valuation data
data.boundary_note: all observations end before the 2026-07-30 forward boundary and remain D0 development evidence

event.shock_return: log return from the first bar open through the third bar close
event.zscore_method: current overlapping 15m return minus the mean of the prior 8640 overlapping 15m returns, divided by their sample standard deviation
event.cooldown: 24 hours from a detected BTC shock; only one market event is counted regardless of how many alt legs trade
event.reaction_bar: the first complete 5m bar after the three-bar BTC shock
event.decision_time: close of the completed reaction bar
event.base_entry_time: next 5m open after the reaction bar closes

features.return: close-to-close 5m log return for beta history; open-to-close log return for the completed reaction bar
features.beta_model: OLS alpha and beta for each alt versus BTC using only returns ending before the BTC shock starts
features.residual_scale: sample standard deviation of prior OLS residuals
features.reaction_score: (alt reaction return - alpha - beta * BTC reaction return) / prior residual scale
features.liquidity_measure: sum quote volume strictly before the BTC shock window
features.capacity_measure: minimum 5m quote volume over the 12 completed bars ending with the reaction bar

portfolio.sleeve_weights: inverse prior residual volatility, normalized to alt longs +0.5 and alt shorts -0.5
portfolio.btc_hedge: negative of selected alt prior beta exposure
portfolio.normalization: divide all signed alt and BTC hedge weights by total absolute weight
portfolio.capacity_rule: reference notional times absolute normalized leg weight must not exceed 2% of that leg's frozen capacity measure; otherwise skip the whole event
portfolio.hold: 60 minutes from each scenario's actual entry
portfolio.overlap: BTC shock cooldown prevents overlapping market events

execution.fees: charge each alt and BTC hedge leg on its simulated entry and exit fill notional
execution.funding: charge every realized funding event with leg_entry_time <= funding_time < leg_exit_time using the mark-price 5m open at the funding timestamp
execution.live_authorization: PAPER_ONLY; no live orders are authorized

interpretation.pass: eligible only for a new point-in-time universe and sub-minute trade/quote replay; not eligible for live trading
interpretation.fail: eliminate this exact specification; any shock threshold, score threshold, selection count, weighting or holding-period change requires a new experiment id
interpretation.prohibited_claim: independent out-of-sample profitability or live-trading value
interpretation.known_bias: the fixed 16-symbol panel is survivor-selected and cannot support a deployable universe claim
interpretation.independence_rule: portfolio event is the unit of analysis; constituent legs must never be counted as independent trades
